This was a short narrative game that I played for the second time after playing it back all the way back in 2017 on my Switch. Given that it was almost 10 years ago, I didn’t remember much of the story, but rebought it on Steam like 3 years ago in anticipation for its sequel. It sat in my library until I went back home without my PC, which prompted me to play this on my laptop. The game can be played on Netflix for Christ sakes, it's incredibly easy to run. I like to review everything I play to completion, and while I don’t have a ton to say about this game, I still want to get some thoughts out. If you're looking for any gameplay whatsoever, this game is not for you. It is an even less engaging, 2D CYOA, with some standard variety of choice. There are very minute differences between the endings which isn’t to say they are bad, but your choices aren’t profound in this game. Where this game excels is its characters and conversational writing. All the main characters have their angst and melodrama, but their interactions are strong, particularly between the main character, Alex, and her new stepbrother, Jonas. Jonas is an outsider to the group dynamic, so he relies on Alex for social and moral support. Seeing their clearly new relationship blossom was cute to see. Other characters like Ren and Nona, were serviceable, but I spent most of my time with Jonas. Clarissa, who is absent from most of the game, is confrontational with Alex due to her inadvertently causing the death of her sister and Clarissa’s ex boyfriend, Micheal. That dynamic, while unexplored between the two girls, is also compelling. Then there's the mystery “ghost” element. The 5 main characters go camping on an island haunted by the ghosts of a crashed submarine who are attempting to possess the bodies of the group in order to escape death. It is your goal as Alex to uncover this mystery and sort of sympathize and humanize with the situation of the ghosts. Everything is compelling enough for a short 3-4 hour runtime and there's some interesting themes here about acceptance of the past, particularly when presented with the opportunity to change things. The game asks if it's worth it to reverse the past if it means bringing back loved ones. Overall an easily digestible, albeit not game changing. 5.5/10

1.文本和对白缺乏质量，无法在几个小时的短流程内撑起所有角色的塑造及剧本的表达。具体表现为：
1）主角的对话三选一不具有分支意义，不管选什么或者不选，都不会对后续剧情发展产生影响
2）对白密集但缺乏信息密度，相当一部分的对话既没有在刻画角色，也没有在揭露世界观或推进剧情，而真的只是白开水一样的闲聊——比如，当主角和队友经历了一次惊悚事件，他们既没有表现出不安和慌乱，也没有对事情进行任何有效的分析，只是进行“我们以前在学校做了什么”“要不要来我的生日派对”这一类对叙事几乎没有任何价值的对话，这种极低的信息密度很大程度破坏了好不容易通过音画表现出的氛围，也加重了玩家的阅读成本
3）基于以上两点，由于本作故事的推进完全依赖角色对话，使得包括主角在内的所有人都不像有血有肉的正常人。情节的逻辑是有理可循的，具体的演绎是无理取闹的。你在游戏中可以看到：带头闯祸卷入神秘事件却把锅甩给主角的男一，刚从危机中逃脱惊魂未定先磕个药的男二，马上全员团灭还在嘴主角的女一等，整个流程都流露出演员无法入戏的生硬感，剧本没写的地方一概不演，推动剧情和解决矛盾的方式极其生硬，以至于到了结束，作为扮演主角的玩家也无法建立起对其中任何一人的情感链接
4）英文配音播音腔很重，比有感情地朗读课文还要无感情
2.游戏流程设计的解谜流程和故事内容的揭露方式相互矛盾，前者设立了一套循序渐进，逐渐拼凑出全貌的模式（虽然是很常见的设计），后者则在前中期就相当直白地揭露了真相，反而让后面的收集流程从“拼凑故事的真相”变成了单纯的“找到玩家本来不知道”的无关紧要的补充类信息，让游戏过早失去了神秘感和惊悚感
3.收音机调频作为本作链接叙事层和机制层的核心设计，本应有更多的戏份，展现更多的互动可能，但其实际表现只是把单击鼠标进入下一段的操作多加了几个键，虽然是意料之中，难免让人失望
4.剧本本身也不出彩，同题材作品里你可以找到很多在叙事和关键情节设计上更好更出色的

[h2]Sinopsis[/h2]
Oxenfree es una fantástica aventura enfocada en la exploración y la narrativa, una historia plagada de misterios sobrenaturales e importantes decisiones que cambiarán el rumbo de los acontecimientos. Alex y sus amigos deciden escaparse a la Isla Edward para celebrar una fiesta en la playa. El plan pintaba divertido: beber, fumar y jugar a juegos alrededor de la hoguera. Sin embargo, cerca de la playa descubren unas laberínticas cuevas, donde la radio de Alex parece emitir extrañas señales. Enfrascados en la búsqueda de aventuras y misterio, los adolescentes se adentran en la cueva, sin sospechar que su intromisión acabaría abriendo una brecha espacio temporal que les pondría a todos ellos en riesgo. Aquí comienza su pesadilla, una noche sobrecogedora donde tendrán que enfrentarse a un peligro del más allá, descubrir los secretos de la isla Edward y su relación con el hundimiento del antiguo submarino USS Kanaloa.

[h2]Jugabilidad / Apartado técnico[/h2]
La jugabilidad de Oxenfree se basa en dos pilares fundamentales: la exploración de la isla y las relaciones sociales con el resto de nuestros compañeros, un factor que impactará en el devenir de los hechos y el desenlace de la aventura. A lo largo de la noche tendremos que cumplir con varios objetivos relacionados con la trama, teniendo cierta libertad para recorrer los distintos rincones de la isla. Una de las mecánicas más relevantes gira en torno a la radio de Alex, un dispositivo que podremos emplear en cualquier momento para descubrir misteriosas frecuencias si nos encontramos en el lugar adecuado, revelando mensajes secretos, anomalías o activando ciertos objetos u eventos. Las conversaciones entre los distintos personajes serán la salsa de la experiencia, ya que fluirán de forma constante y natural, dando forma a las distintas personalidades de cada uno. Durante los diálogos podremos elegir entre 3 opciones diferentes (o permanecer en silencio). Cada respuesta hará que nuestros compañeros nos perciban como alguien positivo y amable, neutral o bien una persona desagradable. Como ya he comentado, nuestra actitud afectará al futuro de nuestros compañeros y modificará el final de la historia de forma relevante, siendo este el punto clave de la experiencia. 

[h2]Valoración[/h2]
Oxenfree es una aventura que se ha granjeado su fama gracias a la naturalidad y humanidad de sus protagonistas, pudiendo encontrar al chistoso, la tímida, el malote o la engreída. Descubrir la historia de cada personaje es la guinda del pastel, ya que nos hará empatizar y comprender mejor a cada uno de ellos. Las conversaciones transcurren constantemente y a tiempo real, contando con un breve lapso de tiempo para contestar o no, lo cual hace que tengamos que prestar atención continua a lo que está ocurriendo y leer rápidamente los bocadillos de texto antes de que desaparezcan. Este aspecto tiene sus pros y contras, ya que hace que sea más realista, pero más exigente, a sabiendas de que contestar sin prestar atención puede desencadenar eventos o situaciones no deseadas. Independientemente de los protagonistas y la parte narrativa/social, el juego da vida a una historia de misterio bastante atractiva, con elementos surrealistas y paranormales que le dan un toque muy interesante. Emplear la radio para descubrir los distintos secretos de la isla y su pasado serán aspectos opcionales, pero muy recomendables, si queremos exprimir todo el jugo de la aventura. Por último, destacar que el juego ofrece cierta rejugabilidad, no solo para experimentar distintas conversaciones y situaciones, si no que, al jugar una 2ª vez, los protagonistas recordarán ciertos eventos del pasado, pero esto tendréis que descubrirlo por vosotros mismos.  En definitiva, un juego sensacional si buscas una buena trama, personajes carismáticos y disfrutas con las novelas/pelis de misterios.

✔️ [b]Positivo[/b]:[list]
[*]Aventura que pone gran énfasis en el desarrollo personal y social de sus protagonistas y la narrativa, actuando con mucha naturalidad y humanidad. 
[*]Ofrece una historia de misterio en la que podremos profundizar de manera opcional, contando con muchos secretos e interesantes mecánicas que giran en torno al uso de una radio portátil.
[*]Gráficamente atractivo, sin demasiadas tareas opcionales que desvíen nuestra atención de la trama y con buenas opciones de rejugabilidad para descubrir distintos desenlaces y consecuencias de nuestros actos. [/list]
❌ [b]Negativo[/b]:[list]
[*]Exige mantener una atención constante y leer rápidamente, ya que las conversaciones ocurren en tiempo real y de nuestra respuesta depende el devenir de la historia. 
[*]En momentos puntuales pueden superponerse eventos, personajes hablando y mensajes de radio, lo que puede llegar a ser agobiante. 
[*]Aunque es interesante poder superar el juego eligiendo distintas personalidades (amable, neutral o desagradable) para ver los diferentes desenlaces, puede resultar algo tedioso, ya que la mayoría de aspectos clave de la trama se repiten, contando con ligeras diferencias entre partidas. [/list]

oh, oxenfree. I love your janky dialogue system and terrifying visuals. 10/10 no notes, make sure to play through twice to get the full story! "RADIO DIAL SIMULATOR"

Jokes aside, steam really should introduce a rating other than like and dislike because my thoughts on this game is definitely a mixed bag.

Would only recommend this game to you If you have got nothing better to do on a certain evening or weekend and you prefer bingeing on shows for a few hours straight and/or looking for a gripping experience. The best aspect of this game has to be the dialogue options which actually does impact the story / ending in significant way. If you are familiar with the works of Telltale Games, Supermassive Games  and Quantic Dream then the dialogue tree/ decisions mechanics and the whole game in general will be up your alley. 

What killed the experience for me were the mechanical and technical aspects of the game.

For starters, the momentum gets killed by constant loading screens and yes, I have got it installed in my SSD, and the loading times were still annoying.

Secondly, the main character "Alex" is a slog to manuever who is constantly being obstructed by environmental geometries.

Thirdly and most importantly, the "Nonchalant" attitude of the protagonist really does kill any kinda tension. If "Alex" is so chill about her current circumstances, then how are we supposed to feel invested or care about the situation. Yes we do get the option to pick serious/concerned/scared dialogue option but such options are few and far between and often times they lack sincerity. Ultimately we end up not caring about the outcomes/fate of the characters which is an integral part of the game. This inevitably ruined the whole game for me.

So if you are not really bothered by these drawbacks and you are into supernatural shows like Dark or Stranger Things, then you are welcome to give this game a try at your own risk. Otherwise don't bother with it and play something else.

[h1] HISTÓRIA [/h1]
É o ponto forte. Um jogo que trata sobre saltos e loops temporais. Todos os personagens são memoráveis e impactantes e as decisões feitas ao longo do jogo mudam não só o final, mas também o meio da história. Importante destacar que para entender melhor o enredo, é necessário rejogar a campanha pelo menos 1 vez.

Obs: Infelizmente não há legendas em português de forma oficial.

[h1] GRÁFICOS [/h1]
Excelentes, ainda mais quando se considera a idade do jogo. Os personagens e cenários são bem feitos e apresentam um bom design.

[h1] GAMEPLAY [/h1]
O jogo consiste em resolver diversos puzzles diferentes, mas que no geral são fáceis em termos de dificuldade. O interessante é que nesse jogo é utilizado ondas de rádio para interagir com os puzzles e avançar na história. Além disso, o principal é a escolha de diálogo com cada personagem, podendo fazer todos te amarem ou te odiarem.

[h1] CONCLUSÃO [/h1]
É um jogo muito curto, que leva em torno de 3h~5h para concluir. Mas nesse curto tempo ele consegue mostrar uma história extremamente interessante, com personagens cativantes e com boa progressão. Há uma leve pitada de suspense na história que ajuda a deixá-la ainda mais interessante. Os coletáveis da ilha do jogo ajudam a entender melhor a história e recomendo procurá-los. Excelente jogo para relaxar e curtir uma boa história.

Если коротко: это редкий пример игры, где атмосфера и диалоги работают лучше, чем любой геймплей.
Главная механика - это разговоры. Реплики выбираются в реальном времени, можно перебивать собеседника, молчать, менять тон. Нет чёткой “правильной” линии поведения. Игра запоминает, кому вы грубили, кого поддерживали, где предпочли промолчать. Это влияет не только на концовку, но и на ощущение химии между персонажами. 

Вторая механика, на которой стоит заострить внимание - это радио. У главной героини есть портативный приемник, с помощью которого она может разгадывать загадки острова, открывать двери и искать скрытые послания. В игре очень много спрятанных сообщений, некоторые даже в виде азбуки Морзе (умельцы в сети уже расшифровали каждое из них, углубив лор игры и предысторию острова). 

Персонажи в игре прекрасны: живые, каждый со своим характером, предысторией и манерами. Никто из них не скатывается в карикатурные «драматичные подростковые архетипы». Они ведут себя как реальные люди, а не как сборник клише.
[b]Алекс[/b] - саркастична, иногда закрыта, временами откровенно уходит в себя. И это не раздражает, а работает на историю.
[b]Рен[/b] - тревожный, болтливый, местами комичный, но при этом очаровательный парень.
[b]Джонас[/b] - сдержанный и неловкий, но постепенно раскрывается как надежный друг. 
[b]Кларисса[/b] - та еще тварь, но по ходу игры понимаешь ее и проникаешься. 
[b]Нона[/b] - няша-скромняша, лучший персонаж в игре, тихая и милая (моя девушка убьет меня, если это прочитает).

Атмосфера в игре задается преимущественно звуком. Звуки острова, радиопомехи, странные сигналы, шорохи, чарующая музыка - все это создает ауру тайны и тревоги. Игра не пугает скримерами, она давит саспенсом.

Игра немного напомнила мне Life is Strange своей атмосферой и подачей. Однако в Oxenfree почти нет главной проблемы LiS - подростковых драм. Трудности персонажей не высосаны из пальца, они обсуждают их как взрослые люди и принимают взвешенные решения. 

[b]Oxenfree - это про атмосферу, про диалоги, про недосказанность. [/b] В ней хочется исследовать каждый камушек (буквально), прослушать каждую линию диалога, прочитать каждую записку, совершить все возможные выборы и посмотреть все концовки. Я прошел игру уже три раза, и ради последней ачивки планирую пройти еще раз.

Oxenfree turns supernatural mystery into a mechanically engaging narrative experience, where dialogue, timing, and exploration drive both story and player agency.

🗣️ Dialogue & Timing Mechanics

The dialogue system is fluid and reactive, replacing traditional menus with a real-time choice wheel. You can interrupt conversations, respond immediately, or let them play out — every choice subtly shifts relationships and story threads. This isn’t just narrative flavor; it’s a mechanical system where timing and selection impact outcomes, unlock optional scenes, and influence character reactions.

👣 Exploration & Environmental Interaction

Movement is simple, but the mechanics of exploration are tightly linked to story discovery. Picking up radios, solving light‑based puzzles, and tracing sound patterns require attentive observation. These tasks reinforce player engagement with the environment and provide mechanical feedback that drives story progression.

📻 Radio & Puzzle Mechanics

The radio is the game’s core interactive tool. Tuning frequencies and triangulating signals isn’t a gimmick — it’s a mechanical puzzle loop. Each radio interaction can reveal hidden information, trigger supernatural events, or progress the plot. Learning to combine movement, listening, and radio use creates a layered, system-based experience.

🧠 Choice, Consequence, & Replayability

Every decision, from dialogue choices to how you explore the island, affects multiple narrative outcomes. The system tracks not just what you say, but how and when you say it, leading to nuanced consequences in character dynamics and ending variations. This makes mechanics and storytelling inseparable.

⚡ Feedback & Engagement

Visual and audio cues provide immediate mechanical feedback — a flicker of light, a distant voice, or character expressions signal impact from your choices. The game reinforces learning organically, encouraging experimentation without punishing curiosity.

10/10 — fluid dialogue mechanics, environmental puzzles, and choice-based systems that make every interaction feel meaningful.

The good:

Story - I haven't tried for all endings, but what I saw through my playthrough was enjoyable.

Art - the overall art (backgrounds, character sprites, photographs) are all very lovely and set the mood for the game.

Voice Acting - Everyone did a great job. I don't think I ran into a case where the voice acting felt off


The bad:

Accessibility: Practically none. You have the option for subtitles and disabling effects. That's it.
Want to change the font because it's hard to read? Oh well
Music too loud? Deal.
Don't have time to read and select the choices? Too bad!

Music - Very loud.
You would think you can go into the settings to turn the music down, but you can't. 
There is /NO/ audio volume in the settings. For anything.
Because of this, it's very hard to hear the character's voices at times.

Choices - These are mostly fine, but sometimes, the choices can be cut off, which is a little annoying
Sometimes, the choices also pop up and leave too fast. I ran into this issue a few times.
Sometimes, you'll select a choice and it immediately interrupts the current conversation and starts the next bit. Sometimes, it doesn't. This is very annoying because you could try to wait for the dialogue to finish, but then the choices just go away and they carry on without you.

Banter - Sometimes, the banter goes on for TOO long.
For example, at the beginning, conversations were constantly interrupted because I had walked too far and triggered the next response prematurely. I feel like it messes with the flow when you're all actively trying to go to a location, but I have to just stop walking and we all stand around while the conversation finishes before I can move on.
You're also sometime given options that, if you select them when they pop up, also interrupt the conversation and goes to the next dialogue chunk. (I think this is bugged, because sometimes it waits until the dialogue is finished)
